newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon rates Zoran a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon rates Zoran a buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers issued a buy recommendation for Zoran Corp, saying the Israeli company will benefit from increasing demand for digital consumer electronics.
Zoran is a leading developer of compression products used in audio and video multimedia applications.

"The demand for digital consumer electronics is expected to soar in the next few years; Zoran's technological expertise places the company in an ideal position to benefit from any rise in demand," analyst Victor Halpert said in a report.
Among Zoran's clients are Samsung, Sony, Toshiba, Dolby Labs and Pioneer.
Salomon Brothers forecast Zoran's earnings per share (EPS) will rise from $0.11 in 1995 to $0.50 in 1996 and $0.89 in 1997.

"In comparison with its international peers, Zoran's expected 1996 P/E (price/earnings ratio) is trading at 31.9 times versus the sector average of 18.1. For 1997, the ratio is favourable for Zoran at 17.9 times versus 30.5 times for its international peers," the report said.
"Zoran is expected to generate the fastest earnings and sales growth in its sector for 1997," it added.
Zoran announced its intention to acquire CompCore Multimedia, a maker of software based compression solutions.
Zoran will issue 2.85 million new shares to CompCore shareholders in a transaction expected to reach $57 million.

"We believe the CompCore acquisition will have an anti-dilutive effect on Zoran's 1997 EPS. In our model we assumed additional sales of around $12 million in 1997 from this acquisition and close to a $1.8 million contribution to net income. Total shares outstanding are expected to rise to 11.3 million," the report said.
